text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the autumn Tenno Sho draws closer, Silence Suzuka questions Matikanefukukitaru about whether she is happy or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanefukukitaru answers that, thanks to her fans and I, she's very happy being able to run her heart out now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, she asks Silence Suzuka the exact same question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka answers that while she isn't quite happy yet, she has the feeling it's almost within reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, Matikanefukukitaru and Silence Suzuka move forward, each seeking their own form of happiness.
